name: open-targets-mcp
description: Open Targets MCP server - TypeScript implementation providing access to Open Targets Platform data

target.get_target_info: Retrieve core identity details for a target gene
target.get_target_alternative_genes: List alternate gene symbols and cross-references
target.get_target_expression: Return RNA and protein expression profiles
target.get_target_pathways_and_go_terms: List pathway memberships and GO annotations
target.get_target_associated_diseases: List diseases linked to a target

disease.get_disease_info: Retrieve core metadata for a disease
disease.get_disease_associated_targets: List targets associated with a disease
disease.get_disease_otar_projects: List OTAR projects linked to a disease

drug.get_drug_info: Fetch identity, indication, and mechanism data
drug.get_drug_linked_diseases: List diseases connected to a drug
drug.get_drug_linked_targets: Return targets linked via mechanism of action

evidence.get_target_disease_evidence: Retrieve evidence strings linking target to disease

search.search_entities: Search and resolve synonyms to canonical IDs

variant.get_variant_credible_sets: List credible sets including a variant
variant.get_variant_evidences: Retrieve evidence strings for a variant
variant.get_variant_intervals: Retrieve E2G predictions overlapping a variant

study.get_study_info: Retrieve metadata for a GWAS study
study.get_credible_set_by_id: Fetch details for a credible set

meta.map_ids: Map free-text terms to canonical IDs
